subject: Brightline vendor setup: privacy evidence handoff, SOC2 link, and PO next steps
messages:
From: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh@brightline-payments.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@brightline-payments.com>, procurement@brightline-payments.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor kickoff — privacy docs and PO questions

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the walkthrough this morning. Procurement is ready to move forward but we need a couple of discrete items before we can create the PO and route for signatures: 

1) Fully executed DPA (we need a PDF we can attach to our contract record).
2) Link to an up-to-date SOC 2 report or hosted read-only page with the auditor letter.
3) A concise subprocessor roster (CSV or spreadsheet) we can import into our vendor registry.
4) Confirmation of Redwood's billing contact and the address you want on the PO.

Can you send those items or point me to where they live? If you prefer, I can start the PO template with provisional details and you can attach the evidence later — but procurement prefers the evidence up front for our legal review.

Appreciate it,
Rajesh
Procurement Manager
Brightline Payments
[Attachment: PO_template_brightline.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh@brightline-payments.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor kickoff — privacy docs and PO questions

Hi Rajesh — thanks for the list and for the quick call today. Attached are the items you requested and a couple notes below: 

- Attached: Brightline_DPA_Signed.pdf (signed copy), Redwood_subprocessors_list.csv (machine-friendly), Redwood_SOC2_2027.html (static export of our SOC 2 reader).
- Billing contact for PO: Redwood Inference, Attn: Billing Ops — billing@redwood.ai, 415-555-0198, Redwood Inference, 125 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94105.
- If procurement needs the live SOC2 reader behind an access control, we can create a time-bound SSO link; see the Drive link I pasted in the metadata.

Two small asks from our side to avoid rework: 
- Please include a contract start date (we typically use the go-live date of the account) and currency (USD).
- If Brightline requires an invoice PO number field, let us know where that appears on your side so invoices map correctly.

I looped in Vivek for any technical questions and Ben for billing/PO routing exceptions.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Procurement Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Brightline_DPA_Signed.pdf (PDF)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh@brightline-payments.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor kickoff — privacy docs and PO questions

Rajesh,

Quick follow-up from the security team: our SOC 2 export includes the auditor letter and control mapping. The static export (Redwood_SOC2_2027.html) should be fine for procurement and legal, but if your legal team needs the auditor portal link or a notarized paper copy, we can get that.

On subprocessors: the CSV contains current production subprocessors; if you need history (onboarding dates/regions), ask and we’ll provide a dated sheet. Note that some subprocessors process metadata only; we can flag those entries.

Ben — can you confirm the invoice remit and whether we can accept a single PO for the initial annual commitment plus a separate invoice for usage overages?

Thanks,
Vivek
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_subprocessors_list.csv (CSV)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh@brightline-payments.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 17:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor kickoff — privacy docs and PO questions

Rajesh — thanks, that all works. Confirming:

- Redwood can accept a single PO for the annual committed fee and will invoice monthly for consumption-based overages under the same PO number. Please add a field "Invoice PO" on your PO template and put the number there (that maps to our AP workflow).
- Remit address as Kim listed. For wiring details, we will send a secure banking instruction PDF via DocuSign (link in related_links).
- We confirm the attached DPA is the fully executed version: Brightline_DPA_Signed.pdf. If legal has redlines, please return them to legal@redwood.ai and we’ll triage.

Next steps: If you can upload the completed PO into your supplier portal, we’ll use that PO number on our outgoing invoices. Otherwise, send the PO PDF to billing@redwood.ai and we’ll route it internally.

I’ll mark this vendor as ready for activation once we receive the PO number and the procurement acknowledgment.

Best,
Ben Carter
Billing & Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_2027.html (HTML export)]
